intro: Darjeeling is one of those places that stays with you long after the trip ends. Tea gardens, toy trains and Kanchenjunga views — and it is easier to plan than you might think.

sections.heading: Why visit Darjeeling
paragraphs: Darjeeling (West Bengal) is known for its hills, tea and heritage experiences. Overall it is budget-friendly — hostels, homestays and local food keep costs low.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is March to May and October to December.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Darjeeling?
